ex.en: There were many delicious snacks at the party.
ex.zh: 派對上有很多好吃的點心。

ex.en: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
ex.zh: 我吃泡麵當宵夜。

ex.en: I never used to eat snacks.
ex.zh: 我以前從不吃零食。

snack.en: a small amount of food eaten between meals

ex.en: Do we have anything I can snack on?
ex.zh: 我們有什麼可以讓我當零食吃的嗎？

ex.en: Try not to snack between meals.
ex.zh: 盡量不要在正餐之間吃零食。

snack.en: to eat small amounts of food between meals

ex.en: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be snowy.
ex.zh: 根據氣象預報，明天會下雪。

ex.en: It's snowy today.
ex.zh: 今天下雪。

ex.en: We drove carefully on the snowy road.
ex.zh: 我們在積雪的路上小心開車。

snowy.en: with white flakes falling from the sky or covering the ground

ex.en: Look at that mountain which is covered with snow.
ex.zh: 看那座被雪覆蓋的山。

ex.en: This year we had more snow than last year.
ex.zh: 今年的雪下得比去年多。

snow.en: soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky in cold weather

ex.en: It snowed for ten days in a row.
ex.zh: 連續下了十天的雪。

ex.en: It hardly ever snows here in the winter.
ex.zh: 這裡冬天幾乎不下雪。

ex.en: When I opened the curtains, it was snowing.
ex.zh: 我拉開窗簾時，外面正在下雪。

snow.en: to fall from the sky as soft white frozen water

ex.en: The B4 and D-sharp-5 strings snapped.
ex.zh: B4 和升 D5 的弦斷了。

ex.en: The branch snapped under his weight.
ex.zh: 樹枝被他壓得啪一聲斷了。

snap.en: to break suddenly with a short loud sound

ex.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to snap at you.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意對你發脾氣的。

ex.en: Don't snap at me; I'm only trying to help.
ex.zh: 別對我兇，我只是想幫忙。

snap.en: to speak to someone in a sudden angry way

ex.en: Tourists were snapping photos of the temple.
ex.zh: 遊客們紛紛為寺廟拍照。

ex.en: I snapped a quick picture with my phone.
ex.zh: 我用手機很快拍了一張照片。

ex.en: A cold snap spread across Europe.
ex.zh: 一股寒流侵襲歐洲。

ex.en: We had a cold snap in early spring.
ex.zh: 初春時來了一波寒流。

snap.en: a short period of sudden cold weather

ex.en: Don't make a snap decision about the offer.
ex.zh: 別倉促決定是否接受這個工作機會。

ex.en: I had to make a snap judgment.
ex.zh: 我必須當機立斷。

ex.en: He told me that he wasn't scared of snakes.
ex.zh: 他跟我說他不怕蛇。

ex.en: He's not at all afraid of snakes.
ex.zh: 他一點都不怕蛇。

ex.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
ex.zh: 光是想到蛇就讓我發抖。

snake.en: a long thin animal with no legs that moves along the ground

ex.en: The road snakes through the mountains.
ex.zh: 這條路在山間蜿蜒。

ex.en: A long line snaked around the building.
ex.zh: 長長的人龍繞著大樓排隊。

snake.en: to move or lie in a long curving line

ex.en: I can't stop sneezing.
ex.zh: 我一直打噴嚏停不下來。

ex.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
ex.zh: 咳嗽、打噴嚏或打哈欠時要遮住嘴巴。

sneeze.en: to suddenly blow air out through your nose in a way you cannot control

ex.en: She let out a loud sneeze.
ex.zh: 她打了一個很大的噴嚏。

ex.en: I felt a sneeze coming on.
ex.zh: 我覺得快要打噴嚏了。

sneeze.en: the sudden loud blowing of air out of your nose

ex.en: The dog sniffed the bag at the airport.
ex.zh: 狗在機場嗅了嗅那個袋子。

ex.en: She sniffed the milk to see if it was fresh.
ex.zh: 她聞了聞牛奶看還新不新鮮。

sniff.en: to smell something by breathing in through your nose

ex.en: Stop sniffing and use a tissue.
ex.zh: 別再吸鼻子了，用面紙吧。

ex.en: He kept sniffing because of his cold.
ex.zh: 他因為感冒一直吸鼻子。

sniff.en: to breathe in noisily through your nose

ex.en: Our auditors sniffed out several errors.
ex.zh: 我們的稽核人員查出了好幾個錯誤。

ex.en: Reporters quickly sniffed out the story.
ex.zh: 記者很快就嗅到了這則新聞。

sniff.en: to find or discover something that is hidden

ex.en: Tom sneaked up behind Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆偷偷溜到瑪麗身後。

ex.en: David decided to sneak into the kitchen and find something delicious to eat.
ex.zh: 大衛決定偷偷溜進廚房，找點好吃的吃。

ex.en: She sneaked a look at her phone during class.
ex.zh: 她上課時偷偷看了一下手機。

sneak.en: to move or do something quietly so that no one notices

ex.en: A seagull swooped down and snatched the sandwich from my hand.
ex.zh: 一隻海鷗俯衝下來，從我手中叼走了三明治。

ex.en: The child snatched the toy away from his sister.
ex.zh: 那個孩子從妹妹手中把玩具搶了過去。

ex.en: I snatched a quick nap before the meeting.
ex.zh: 我在會議前趁機小睡了一會兒。

ex.en: She snatched the chance to speak with the director.
ex.zh: 她抓住了和導演說話的機會。

ex.en: The thief made a quick snatch at her bag.
ex.zh: 小偷迅速地搶了她的包包一下。

ex.en: I only caught a snatch of their conversation.
ex.zh: 我只聽到他們談話的片段。

ex.en: I bought a new pair of white sneakers yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天買了一雙新的白色運動鞋。

ex.en: Wear sneakers if you want to walk around the old town.
ex.zh: 如果你想逛老城區，就穿運動鞋吧。

ex.en: She showed me a snapshot of her family on the beach.
ex.zh: 她給我看一張全家在海灘的快照。

ex.en: This is just a snapshot of what life was like back then.
ex.zh: 這只是當時生活樣貌的一個縮影。

ex.en: The software takes a snapshot of your files every night.
ex.zh: 這個軟體每晚都會為你的檔案建立一份快照。

ex.en: You can restore the system from an earlier snapshot.
ex.zh: 你可以從較早的快照還原系統。

ex.en: A sniper took position on the roof.
ex.zh: 一名狙擊手在屋頂上就位。

ex.en: The police asked the sniper to wait for orders.
ex.zh: 警方要求狙擊手等待命令。

ex.en: He snorted with laughter when he heard the joke.
ex.zh: 他聽到笑話後忍不住哼著鼻子笑出聲。

ex.en: The horse snorted and shook its head.
ex.zh: 那匹馬噴了噴鼻息，搖了搖頭。

ex.en: She gave a snort of disbelief.
ex.zh: 她不以為然地哼了一聲。

ex.en: We heard the snort of a pig in the barn.
ex.zh: 我們聽見穀倉裡傳來豬噴鼻息的聲音。

ex.en: A snail slowly crossed the garden path.
ex.zh: 一隻蝸牛慢慢爬過花園小徑。

ex.en: Snails come out after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨後蝸牛會出來活動。

ex.en: The traffic moved at a snail's pace this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上車流像蝸牛一樣緩慢移動。

ex.en: My old computer is a snail compared to the new one.
ex.zh: 我的舊電腦跟新的比起來慢得像蝸牛。

ex.en: My grandfather plays snooker with his friends every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我爺爺每週六都和朋友打司諾克。

ex.en: Snooker is played on a larger table than pool.
ex.zh: 司諾克用的球桌比美式撞球的大。

ex.en: The sudden rule change snookered our plans for the trip.
ex.zh: 突然改變的規定打亂了我們的旅行計畫。

ex.en: I felt snookered when both of my options disappeared.
ex.zh: 兩個選擇都沒了，我覺得自己被困住了。

ex.en: We hit a snag when the printer stopped working.
ex.zh: 印表機壞掉時，我們遇到了小狀況。

ex.en: The plan sounds good, but there's one snag.
ex.zh: 這計畫聽起來不錯，只是有一個小問題。

ex.en: My sweater snagged on a nail and tore.
ex.zh: 我的毛衣被釘子勾到，破了。

ex.en: Be careful not to snag your sleeve on the fence.
ex.zh: 小心別讓袖子被圍籬勾住。

ex.en: I managed to snag the last ticket for the concert.
ex.zh: 我設法搶到了演唱會的最後一張票。

ex.en: She snagged a window seat on the train.
ex.zh: 她在火車上搶到了靠窗的座位。

ex.en: My brother snores so loudly that I can't sleep.
ex.zh: 我哥哥鼾聲太大，我睡不著。

ex.en: Do you snore when you have a cold?
ex.zh: 你感冒的時候會打呼嗎？

ex.en: A loud snore came from the next room.
ex.zh: 隔壁房間傳來很大的鼾聲。

ex.en: His snore woke the baby.
ex.zh: 他的鼾聲把寶寶吵醒了。

ex.en: The dog snarled at the stranger.
ex.zh: 那隻狗對陌生人低聲咆哮。

ex.en: "Get out of my way," he snarled.
ex.zh: 「別擋我的路。」他厲聲吼道。

ex.en: The wind snarled her long hair.
ex.zh: 風把她的長髮吹得糾結成一團。

ex.en: An accident snarled traffic for hours.
ex.zh: 一場事故讓交通癱瘓好幾個小時。

ex.en: The tiger let out a low snarl.
ex.zh: 老虎發出一聲低吼。

ex.en: I couldn't undo the snarl in the fishing line.
ex.zh: 我解不開釣魚線上打結的那一團。

ex.en: We sat in a snug little room by the fire.
ex.zh: 我們坐在壁爐邊舒適溫暖的小房間裡。

ex.en: The jacket is a snug fit, so I need a bigger size.
ex.zh: 這件外套穿起來很緊，我需要大一點的尺寸。

ex.en: A single snowflake landed on my glove and melted.
ex.zh: 一片雪花落在我的手套上，然後就融化了。

ex.en: Every snowflake has a slightly different shape.
ex.zh: 每一片雪花的形狀都略有不同。

ex.en: Don't sneer at people who are trying their best.
ex.zh: 別嘲笑那些正在盡全力的人。

ex.en: He sneered at my old car.
ex.zh: 他對我的舊車嗤之以鼻。

ex.en: She answered with a sneer and walked away.
ex.zh: 她冷笑著回答，然後走開了。

ex.en: There was a sneer in his voice when he spoke.
ex.zh: 他說話的語氣中帶著嘲諷。

ex.en: The snowstorm closed all the roads in the area.
ex.zh: 暴風雪讓該地區所有道路都封閉了。

ex.en: We stayed home during the snowstorm and drank hot tea.
ex.zh: 暴風雪期間我們待在家裡喝熱茶。

ex.en: The kids threw snowballs at each other in the yard.
ex.zh: 孩子們在院子裡互相丟雪球。

ex.en: He packed a hard snowball and aimed it at the tree.
ex.zh: 他捏了一顆硬雪球，瞄準那棵樹。

ex.en: A small mistake can snowball into a huge problem.
ex.zh: 一個小錯誤可能會愈滾愈大，變成大問題。

ex.en: Her online business snowballed within a few months.
ex.zh: 她的網路事業在幾個月內迅速壯大起來。

ex.en: We rode a snowmobile across the frozen lake.
ex.zh: 我們騎著雪地摩托車穿越結冰的湖面。

ex.en: Rescue workers used a snowmobile to reach the cabin.
ex.zh: 救援人員騎雪地摩托車抵達了那間小木屋。

ex.en: The kids snuggled up to their mother on the sofa.
ex.zh: 孩子們在沙發上依偎著媽媽。

ex.en: I like to snuggle under a warm blanket on cold nights.
ex.zh: 寒冷的夜晚，我喜歡窩在暖暖的毯子底下。

ex.en: The first snowfall of the year came in early December.
ex.zh: 今年的第一場雪在十二月初降下。

ex.en: Heavy snowfall closed the mountain road for two days.
ex.zh: 大雪讓山路封閉了兩天。

ex.en: She snipped the thread with small scissors.
ex.zh: 她用小剪刀剪斷了線。

ex.en: He snipped a few roses from the garden.
ex.zh: 他從花園剪了幾朵玫瑰。

ex.en: With one snip, the ribbon fell to the floor.
ex.zh: 一剪之下，緞帶掉到地上。

ex.en: She cut a snip of cloth for the test.
ex.zh: 她剪了一小片布來做測試。

ex.en: The pig pushed its snout into the mud.
ex.zh: 豬把鼻子拱進泥巴裡。

ex.en: The dog's snout was wet from the rain.
ex.zh: 狗的口鼻被雨淋濕了。

ex.en: He snuffed the candle before leaving the room.
ex.zh: 他離開房間前熄滅了蠟燭。

ex.en: Strong winds snuffed out the little flame.
ex.zh: 強風把小火苗吹熄了。

ex.en: Snuff was popular among some people in the eighteenth century.
ex.zh: 鼻菸在十八世紀對一些人來說很流行。

ex.en: He kept a small box of snuff in his coat pocket.
ex.zh: 他的外套口袋裡放著一小盒鼻菸。

ex.en: He felt hurt when his classmates snubbed him at lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐時同學冷落他，讓他很受傷。

ex.en: The star snubbed the reporters and walked straight to her car.
ex.zh: 那位明星不理記者，直接走向她的車。

ex.en: Not being invited to the party felt like a snub.
ex.zh: 沒被邀請參加派對，讓人覺得像是被冷落。

ex.en: The minister's absence was seen as a snub to the host country.
ex.zh: 部長缺席被視為對主辦國的怠慢。

ex.en: The rabbit was caught in a snare.
ex.zh: 那隻兔子被陷阱困住了。

ex.en: Be careful, the offer could be a snare to trick you.
ex.zh: 小心，這個提議可能是騙你上當的圈套。

ex.en: Hunters used wire to snare small animals.
ex.zh: 獵人用鐵絲網來捕捉小動物。

ex.en: The police managed to snare the thief with a fake ad.
ex.zh: 警方用一則假廣告成功誘捕了小偷。

ex.en: I only heard a snippet of their conversation.
ex.zh: 我只聽到他們對話的一小段。

ex.en: The article starts with a short snippet from a famous speech.
ex.zh: 這篇文章以一段著名演說的摘錄開頭。

ex.en: He gave me a sneaky smile before taking the last cookie.
ex.zh: 他在拿走最後一塊餅乾前，對我露出狡猾的笑容。

ex.en: It was a sneaky trick to win the game.
ex.zh: 那是贏得比賽的一個狡猾手段。

ex.en: She strapped on a snowshoe and stepped into the deep snow.
ex.zh: 她綁上雪鞋，踏進深深的雪中。

ex.en: A snowshoe spreads your weight so you don't sink.
ex.zh: 雪鞋能分散體重，讓你不會陷下去。

ex.en: We like to snowshoe through the quiet forest in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天我們喜歡穿雪鞋走過寧靜的森林。

ex.en: They snowshoed up the hill to see the sunrise.
ex.zh: 他們穿雪鞋爬上山丘看日出。

ex.en: He bought a new snowboard for the winter trip.
ex.zh: 他為冬季旅行買了一塊新的滑雪板。

ex.en: I fell off my snowboard three times on the first day.
ex.zh: 第一天我從滑雪板上摔了三次。

snowdonia.zh: 斯諾登尼亞（威爾斯北部的山區國家公園）

ex.en: Snowdonia is a national park in north Wales.
ex.zh: 斯諾登尼亞是威爾斯北部的一座國家公園。

ex.en: Many hikers visit Snowdonia to climb its mountains.
ex.zh: 許多健行者前往斯諾登尼亞攀登那裡的山。

ex.en: He is a snob who only talks to rich people.
ex.zh: 他是個勢利眼，只跟有錢人說話。

ex.en: Don't be a snob about the food just because it's cheap.
ex.zh: 別因為食物便宜就擺出一副看不起的樣子。

ex.en: The ad has a snappy slogan that is easy to remember.
ex.zh: 這則廣告的標語簡潔有力，容易記住。

ex.en: Make it snappy, or we'll miss the bus.
ex.zh: 動作快點，不然我們會錯過公車。

ex.en: He wore a snappy new suit to the interview.
ex.zh: 他穿著一套時髦的新西裝去面試。

ex.en: She always looks snappy in that red jacket.
ex.zh: 她穿那件紅外套總是看起來很俐落時髦。

ex.en: Please don't snoop around in my room while I'm away.
ex.zh: 我不在的時候，請不要在我房間裡東翻西找。

ex.en: The neighbors like to snoop on everyone who walks by.
ex.zh: 鄰居們喜歡窺探每一個路過的人。

ex.en: My little brother is a real snoop who reads my messages.
ex.zh: 我弟弟是個愛打探的人，會偷看我的訊息。

ex.en: She took a quick snoop through the files on his desk.
ex.zh: 她快速窺探了一下他桌上的檔案。

ex.en: Critics continue to snipe at the mayor's new plan.
ex.zh: 批評者持續抨擊市長的新計畫。

ex.en: The two coworkers often snipe at each other in meetings.
ex.zh: 這兩位同事常在會議上互相冷嘲熱諷。

ex.en: A snipe is a small bird that lives near wetlands.
ex.zh: 沙錐是一種住在濕地附近的小型鳥類。

ex.en: We spotted a snipe walking in the mud.
ex.zh: 我們看到一隻沙錐在泥地裡走動。

ex.en: The baby was wrapped snugly in a soft blanket.
ex.zh: 寶寶被柔軟的毯子暖暖地包裹著。

ex.en: These boots fit snugly around my ankles.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子緊貼著我的腳踝。

ex.en: Put the snorkel in your mouth and breathe slowly.
ex.zh: 把呼吸管放進嘴裡，慢慢呼吸。

ex.en: I forgot my mask and snorkel at the hotel.
ex.zh: 我把面罩和呼吸管忘在旅館了。

ex.en: We snorkeled over the coral reef all morning.
ex.zh: 我們整個早上都在珊瑚礁上浮潛。

ex.en: Do you want to snorkel or sit on the beach?
ex.zh: 你想去浮潛還是坐在沙灘上？

ex.en: The kids built a snowman in the front yard.
ex.zh: 孩子們在前院堆了一個雪人。

ex.en: We gave the snowman a carrot for a nose.
ex.zh: 我們給雪人裝了一根紅蘿蔔當鼻子。

ex.en: There was a lot of snobbery among the members of the golf club.
ex.zh: 這個高爾夫球俱樂部的會員之間有很多勢利眼的作風。

ex.en: Her snobbery made it hard for her to make friends at school.
ex.zh: 她的勢利讓她很難在學校交到朋友。

ex.en: Some students began to snicker when the teacher tripped.
ex.zh: 老師絆倒時，有些學生開始竊笑。

ex.en: He tried not to snicker at his friend's silly hat.
ex.zh: 他努力不去偷笑朋友那頂傻氣的帽子。

ex.en: I heard a snicker from the back of the classroom.
ex.zh: 我聽到教室後面傳來一聲竊笑。

ex.en: His joke got a snicker from the crowd.
ex.zh: 他的笑話引來人群中的一陣竊笑。

ex.en: The little girl began to sniffle after she fell.
ex.zh: 小女孩跌倒後開始抽鼻子。

ex.en: He sniffled all night because of his cold.
ex.zh: 他因為感冒，整晚都在吸鼻子。

ex.en: I have a bit of a sniffle today.
ex.zh: 我今天有點鼻塞。

ex.en: A little sniffle won't keep me from work.
ex.zh: 一點小感冒不會讓我不去上班。
